title: TS-44 Gate round 2B: fix the static-only weak features
description:
Source: the fresh re-audit report at /tmp/ts/reaudit.md (read the per-feature blocks for your features). Rules: features stay the spec (Gherkin text of existing scenarios unchanged); cucumber-js steps drive production code; every fixed or new scenario group gets a recorded mutation check (break production, scenario fails, restore); no new Python; push with an explicit refspec (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>), never plain git push.

Fix the static-only WEAK findings: consequential_binding_control (takeover scenarios assert flags only requireTakeover sets and nothing in production calls it: drive a real browser action through the gate); overnight_gated_action ('does not retry' asserts a constant); v1_security_policy_exclusions (3 rows are method-absent probes: make them probe real behavior); web_task_list (never runs web code: run it); customer_computer_image (the step performs the assume-role itself); organization_spend_ceiling_computer ('no computer is started' cannot fail because no start job is consumed: consume the start queue); conversation_turn_grant_computer (never shows a path outside /workspace denied); messages_shared_computer and shared_computer (isolation comes from the test's per-tenant disk map: use the production isolation); customer_account_provisioning, customer_snapshot_bucket_template, organization_spend_ceiling_provisioning, computer_ecs_host_starter (greps source: drive the starter), customer_computer_host_front_door (test double), agent_terminal_host_worker_escalation. For each: either make the Then able to fail or, if it genuinely cannot, record exactly why in the closing report.
right_now_summary: The team must replace static checks with real behavior tests and record mutation checks.
